description: Create a hosted pricing model, with no version yet: add one with train_hosted_model or upload_hosted_model_version. A demand model outputs the chance of a sale and its price sensitivity, and the optimizer prices from that; a price model outputs a price, or a ratio of the current price. Names are unique in a workspace (409 when the name is taken). Answers 404 not_released while hosted models (the hosted-pricing-models release) are not switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with function publish scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

auto_promote.description: Make a nightly candidate active when it beats the active version on held-out quotes. Defaults to false.

auto_retrain.description: A demand model only: train a new candidate every night from your outcomes. Defaults to false.

kind.description: demand: outputs a demand curve the optimizer prices from. price: outputs a price or a ratio.

name.description: A name for the model, unique in your workspace.

name: create_hosted_model
